_comment: Upstream drift probes for the suggested-setups signature catalog. Per integration: raw source URLs (the files the signatures were verified against) and literal strings that must still appear there. Checked weekly by .github/workflows/signature-drift.yml; a tripwire test keeps this file in sync with SIGNATURES. Strings are chosen per entry to survive code style (e.g. LG probes the UPPERCASE enum members because the lowercase values are StrEnum auto()).
